_comment: RECONSTRUCTED replay of the S1 v2 wave (parallel-automate/21 Part B evidence): two lanes asked 15 questions in 10 deferred calls. The original question files are not in this repository, so the wording here is reconstructed from the requirement's classification; what is pinned is the shape. 8 routine questions carry the catalog code their gate has once item 21 lands (2 x AUT-RESUME, 1 x AUT-QUEUE, 1 x LP-SAVE, 3 x AUT-SUMMARY, 1 x SUP-CHILDREN); the 7 real decisions are uncoded (a refine on a MEDIUM finding, save-with-notes vs re-review on 4 LOW notes) or carry a human-only code (an output-gap adjudication, 4 fix-now/follow-up picks on MEDIUM findings). With a policy covering the routine codes, exactly 7 questions must reach the human. Read by test-lane-policy.sh.
